review: Each input_predecode DWORD gathers the same four striped lane bytes as the original current_block parser: lane3 as MSB through lane0 as LSB. All16 indices are covered.

Literal STP length/CRC/parity, encoded length and TLP expected-byte expressions conserve their original widths and MAX_ENCODED_BYTES predicate. New32-bit packing is13 encoded+1 header fault+13 expected+5 token bits.

Each four-DWORD step shifts128 metadata bits, corresponding exactly to32 bits removed separately from each128-bit lane bank. The new high four metadata DWORDs use predecode_word(0), preserving encoded underflow and IDL facts rather than incorrectly zeroing decode.

At last slice with a resident next block, both current banks receive the old next banks. Simultaneous incoming replacement writes both next banks later viaNBA; it cannot overwrite the old-next association transferred to current.

At last slice without resident next or with current invalid, ingress overrides both current data and decode assignments together. Otherwise both next banks receive ingress. Held/invalid banks remain paired.
Reset initializes companion banks by decoding the actual zero block. Flush/abort/end clear validity with matching data/companion hold; no parse of stale invalid bank is newly enabled.

EDS stored bit is only literal equality; original slice==3 and j/control_word==3 qualification remains at use. Header_first and same-slice new STP use corresponding decoded word indices; no location or parser-mode predicate moved into the cache.

Whole inverse bridge leaves sequential priority, CRC functions, commit/verdict/retirement and public latency behavior byte-identical outside the15 explicit substitutions and added companion declarations.
scope: Independent current source hashes, literal inverse reconstruction and manual dataflow/priority review only. No author HDL/control execution rerun, native mapping, SAT/formal proof or timing acceptance. Companion equivalence assumes/reset-establishes data-decode association; not arbitrary independent corruption or arbitrary-X equivalence of added state.
